hotels.title: Italian-Inspired Victoria High Country Winery Hideaway with Wine Tasting & Daily Breakfast Hamper
hotels.description: Escape to this secluded, sustainable sanctuary, a hidden gem cradled within King Valley’s undulating landscape and rustic charm. Here, industrial meets idyllic as luxuriously appointed shipping containers transform into designer havens, complete with large windows that frame sweeping views of verdant vineyards that stretch as far as the eye can see. Enjoy a welcome bottle of locally-made wine full of authentic Italian flavours and discover the estate’s intimate Cellar Door, just steps away. Meander through family-owned vineyards and find the perfect picnic spot to set up your daily breakfast hamper, sample award-winning prosecco, or venture further to discover hidden waterfalls and mountain trails. As twilight falls, gather around the crackling firepit while a blanket of stars unfurls above.
